subject: CEASE AND DESIST: Unauthorized Marvel Content in Your World
body:
RE: Unauthorized Use of Protected Characters and Likenesses

Dear Whoever you are,

It has come to our attention that your world contains unlicensed Iron Man suits, a non-canonical Infinity Gauntlet, and more breaches of Marvel intellectual property.

You are hereby instructed to CEASE AND DESIST all unauthorized heroics, including but not limited to: flying, snapping, repulsor blasts, and saying "I am Iron Man".

Please return all Infinity Stones to our legal department within 30 in-game days.

Sincerely,
The Legal Department
The Walt Disney Company
